action_items.text: The project manager will write up the meeting minutes.
The user interface designer will work on the layout of the remote.
The user interface designer will work on the layout of the LCD screen menu.
The industrial designer will work on the functional aspects of the remote.

decisions.text: The remote will have an LCD screen.
The remote will have speech recognition.
The advanced functions such as audio settings, contrast and channel programming will be accessed through the screen.
The target group will be aged 16-40.
A teletext option will not be included.
The remote will be for TV only.
The remote will feature the corporate logo.
The remote will feature the corporate colour.
The screen will be at the top of the remote.
The microphone will be at the top of the remote.
There will be LEDs under the buttons.
Buttons in use will light up.
